text: The Patriots face the Raiders on Sunday in a matchup complicated by a significant secondary injury crisis, as starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis will both be unavailable, though the good news includes the return of defensive tackle Christian Barmore from a one-game shoulder absence and running back Rhamondre Stevenson remaining active. Wide receiver Mack Hollins and offensive lineman Reggie Gilliam have been placed on injured reserve, prompting the team to add special-teams ace Brenden Schooler and cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster in response. The Patriots will honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during Sunday's halftime ceremony at Gillette Stadium, marking a celebration of the franchise's storied history as Robert Kraft reflects on parallels between the 2001 Super Bowl team and this year's squad. The Raiders, meanwhile, bring their own momentum behind Kirk Cousins' surprisingly strong start to the season, making for an intriguing Week 5 battle that kicks off at 1 PM ET with the Patriots sporting throwback uniforms.
